title: Kha'Zix reroll: the whole game, state by state
notes: Annotated from the VOD on 2026-09-24 by reading paused frames in the owner's browser: HUD fields (gold, HP, level, XP, streak, shop, lobby) are read directly and carry confidence 1; boards are deduced from the trait panel and the units visible, listed only when identifiable, with confidence 0.3–0.7 (the unit itself, its hex and its items are approximate). Most rounds have one state (end of planning); 2-3, 2-5, 4-1, 4-5 have start and end. Income events that were not visible (PvE drops, wisps) show up as residuals in the decisions rather than being invented.
